module_summary: Nine-state motor-control Moore FSM: pulses f after reset, detects x=101, then asserts g and latches it on or off depending on y.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 4-bit state register sequencing reset pulse, x 101 detection and y monitoring; decodes f, g.

anchors.name: g
anchors.why: Motor control output decoded from G1, G2, P1; permanently high or low after y check.

anchors.name: f
anchors.why: One-cycle motor control pulse decoded from state B after reset release.

groups.name: motor_fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic on x and y, state register and Moore decode of f and g.
